notes: Based on PDB 5DHB (1.80 Å resolution). GMP (5′-guanosine monophosphate) is the nascent nucleotide being positioned at the 3′-end of an RNA primer for extension — this is an RNA-dependent RNA primer-template complex. GMP guanine stacks on the terminal adenosine A7 of the primer (3.38 Å confirmed). The 5′-phosphate of GMP interacts with template backbone phosphates. Watson-Crick template pairing expected with the complementary C residue on the template strand. ligandPhosphateWeight fires (1P in GMP) — enrichment AUC 0.35 with initial decoys. Note: GMP is being ADDED to the primer, not binding a riboswitch — this case tests nucleotide binding to an RNA template, not gene regulation.
